item.title: Account Consolidation
item.description: Account consolidation merges every duplicate Layer5 Cloud account that belongs to one person into a single canonical account. The canonical account takes ownership of the duplicates’ designs, connections, memberships, roles, and other data, keeps their email addresses so old sign-ins still land in the right place, and retires the duplicates. Consolidation exists so that each person has exactly one account, and so that Layer5 Cloud can enforce one active account per email address.
